review.summary: Café finances face severe input cost pressures, including a 42.04 percent jump in espresso bean prices and multiple supplier invoice discrepancies totaling thousands of dinars in over-invoicing and quantity mismatches. Operational issues include oversold inventory for Schweppes Tonic Water, falling demand for Karamel latte and Kafa latte, and several items at risk of stockout or expiration.

actions.action: Investigate unrecorded deliveries and place a reorder of 12 units for Schweppes Tonic Water
actions.why: Inventory analysis revealed -4 remaining units due to 28 used against 24 delivered, causing stockout risk and an oversold event.

actions.action: Negotiate supplier bean prices, raise Kafa latte pricing, and dispute invoice AP-F-ZP-2026-01197
actions.why: Espresso bean purchase prices jumped 42.04 percent, compressing Kafa latte margins from 76.31 to 68.32 percent, while invoice AP-F-ZP-2026-01197 over-invoiced 22 units of espresso against 20 delivered with an impact of 5880 RSD.

actions.action: Hold payment for invoice AP-F-MD-2026-55271 due to expired plant milk delivery
actions.why: Mlečni Dvor delivered expired Biljni napitak ovas 1 l on 2026-11-26 that had expired on 2026-11-20, impacting 3744 RSD.

actions.action: Contact suppliers Osvežavajuća Pića and Hmelj i Slad to correct price and quantity discrepancies
actions.why: Invoices contain over-invoicing on Coca-Cola 0,25 l (impact 806.4 RSD), undelivered Sprite quantities (impact 2016 RSD), and undelivered Jelen pivo quantities (impact 2880 RSD).

actions.action: Review recipes or run promotions for plunging items like Karamel latte and Kafa latte, and reconsider Jogurt 180 g
actions.why: Karamel latte demand dropped 82.05 percent, Kafa latte fell 48.57 percent, and Jogurt 180 g shows stalled demand and a low 45 percent margin.

actions.action: Run promotions for at-risk hot chocolate powder and non-alcoholic beer before year-end, and address stockout risks
actions.why: Topla čokolada prah and Bezalkoholno pivo face high inventory waste risks by 2026-12-31, while whipping cream, Fanta, and IVI juice show book stockouts.
